notes: 5.62.0 gave custom FIELDS an editor and a delete guard. Putting them beside custom INDICATORS is what made the asymmetry visible, and one half of it was not cosmetic. ci_ was screenable and unguarded, and had been since 5.4.0. indicator-registry publishes every custom indicator into screener.listFields() as ci_<name> and ci_<name>_<plot>, so a saved screen, a cohort's inline spec, a rule condition, a strategy's ranking expression or a cf_ could all gate on one. delete_custom_indicator spliced the record out anyway, and redefining overwrote in place — silently moving the membership of every coh
